Experience

Ascent Business Technology Software Developer

Jan 2024 - Present Gurugram, Haryana

Developed and optimized reactive forms and configurable components in React, leveraging Hooks, Context API, and custom reusable components, which improved form validation speed and reduced code duplication. • Built scalable, real-time Policy Management module (GRC product) with React and Spring Boot, using state

management and lazy loading to ensure seamless synchronization and eﬃcient performance.

Full-Stack Expertise: Implemented backend solutions using Java, Spring boot leds to improving API response time by 25% and Designed and implemented responsive user interfaces, configurable form with React js which leading to a 15% improvement in user satisfaction.

Executed client change requests by analyzing requirements and delivering UI/UX enhancements in React with WebSockets-driven live updates, ensuring 100% on-time delivery.

Resolved frontend and backend bugs by debugging React components, state issues, and API interactions deliver high-quality solutions.

QA Infotech Software Engineer

Feb 2022 - Aug 2022 Noida, UP, India • Built RESTful APIs using Spring Boot for CRUD operations with proper HTTP status codes, exception handling and

secured REST APIs with JWT-based authentication

Education

DIT University Bachelor of Technology(B.Tech) in Mechanical Engineering

2016 - 2020 Dehradun, India

NIIT StackRoute Institute Full-Stack Software Development

Oct 2022 - Nov 2023

Technical Skills

Languages: JAVA, JavaScript, HTML, CSS Technologies: Spring Boot, React JS, Angular, Microservices, MySQL, RESTful API, Hibernate, Docker, MongoDB, GIT Concepts: Problem Solving, Unit Testing, Debugging and Troubleshooting

Projects

KanBan Board | React, MySQL, Spring Boot, Microservices, MongoDB

A kanban board is an agile project management tool designed to help visualize work and maximize eﬃciency, using React, MySQL, Spring Boot Application.

Built reusable React components for task cards, lists, and modals, improving code maintainability UI consistency and reusability.

Implemented real-time updates with WebSockets to sync task status across multiple users simultaneously. • Integrated backend microservices with React frontend via REST APIs, ensuring smooth task creation, assignment, and tracking.

SongPlay(SPOTIFY) Music Application | Spring Boot, React, MySQL

Created a music streaming interface in React where users can browse tracks and manage playlists. • Implemented React Router for seamless navigation and Integrated REST APIs to fetch and manage music data, ensuring a smooth and fast user experience.
